chapter: Army years and joining Bunk Johnson
title: Townsmen band, Army service, and first meeting with Bunk Johnson in New York
summary: He plays in the Townsmen swing band, serves in Army bands in Kentucky and Indiana, then goes to New York, sits in with Bunk Johnson, plays the Town Hall concert and records for Rudi Blesh in 1946.
